summary: Halloween weekend: Pasco Día de los Muertos run with same-day entry, Whitworth Cyclocross in Spokane, Cougar Mountain 50K, two-day Edgefield Cyclocross Crusade, Evergreen trail work, and two direct Grindline Gravel Club invitations. Mountain access is deteriorating: NPS lists Sunrise, Stevens Canyon and White River roads closed for the season; all Mount Rainier vehicles must carry chains starting Nov 1. Thunder River 50K/25K registration is closed and excluded. No confirmed PNW AIARE course, public avalanche webinar, ski conditions, or motorcycle track day worth recommending this weekend. Weather descriptions are planning-level estimates, not verified point forecasts.

recommendations.title: Día de los Muertos Pasco 5K / 10K / Half Marathon
recommendations.weather: Cool late-October conditions, roughly 40s mornings and 50s afternoons; confirm daily forecast and wind
recommendations.description: Local scholarship-fundraiser race; organizer lists same-day registration even though online registration is closed. Race start near 109 S 4th Ave.
recommendations.why: A genuine local race with a half-marathon option ahead of Gilbert and easy social connections.

recommendations.title: Whitworth Cyclocross — Inland Empire Racing
recommendations.timing: Sun Nov 1; registration closes Sat Oct 31 at 11 PM
recommendations.weather: Cool fall weather; morning frost and showers possible; check latest forecast
recommendations.description: Confirmed Nov 1 cyclocross race at 300 W Hawthorne Rd, Spokane. Presented by Inland Empire Racing.
recommendations.why: Closest confirmed regional cyclocross race, strong fit for bike racing and meeting regional riders.

recommendations.title: Cougar Mountain 50K / 19.5 mi / 7.6 mi / 5K
recommendations.location: Sky Country Trailhead, Cougar Mountain, Newcastle/Bellevue, WA
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: Forested singletrack race with four distances and a Halloween costume contest. Organizer says online entry through Oct 28 at 11:59 PM and event-day registration is available; 50K has a nine-hour cutoff.
recommendations.why: Excellent ultra-training race, with a 19.5-mile alternative if avoiding a full 50K effort.

recommendations.title: Cyclocross Crusade Halloween Doubleheader — Edgefield
recommendations.timing: Sat Oct 31 and Sun Nov 1; Saturday costume racing
recommendations.cost: Race entry + OBRA membership; single-race license $5
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: OBRA-sanctioned race #5 and #6 with Saturday costume theme, Sunday series finale and a redesigned spectator-friendly course. Online registration closes Fri at 1 PM; day-of registration available.
recommendations.why: Best one-off cyclocross weekend, with two races and Halloween atmosphere.

recommendations.title: Grindline Gravel Club Ride #5 — A and B Routes
recommendations.location: Start location not included in Strava email; confirm in event
recommendations.driveTime: Unconfirmed until meeting point is checked
recommendations.weather: Cool late-October conditions, roughly 40s mornings and 50s afternoons; confirm daily forecast and wind
recommendations.description: Two direct Strava invitations dated Oct 26 confirm separate A and B routes at 8 AM Saturday. Event start, mileage and elevation were not in the emails; open the Strava invitation before traveling.
recommendations.why: High-value inbox-only social gravel ride with two route options.

recommendations.title: Raging River — Upper Last Call Trail Work Party
recommendations.timing: Sun Nov 1; see volunteer calendar for check-in
recommendations.cost: Free volunteer event; parking pass may apply
recommendations.weather: Cold, wet, and possible early snow or freeze-thaw; check pass and trail status
recommendations.description: Evergreen lists a Nov 1 work party on Upper Last Call at Raging River. Bring work clothes and verify registration, meeting point and any closure changes.
recommendations.why: Community-building opportunity at a trail network already on your MTB wishlist.

recommendations.title: Pumpkin Man Road Bike + Trail Run Duathlon
recommendations.cost: Individual $55; relay $30; online fees may apply
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: Hilly 10-mile road bike leg followed by a technical 5-mile trail run. Halloween-themed duathlon with individual and relay entries.
recommendations.why: Unusually good crossover event for your cycling and trail-running fitness.

recommendations.title: Cross Revolution #3 — Celebration Park
recommendations.timing: Sun Nov 1; online registration closes Fri Oct 30 at 10 AM
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: Confirmed Cross Revolution race #3 at 1095 S 324th St; multiple categories and distances. Check race-day registration policy if online window is missed.
recommendations.why: Another competitive WA cyclocross option on Sunday.

recommendations.title: Evergreen Tech-O-Ween Trail Dig
recommendations.timing: Sat Oct 31; check calendar for start time
recommendations.location: Port Gamble Forest Heritage Park, Kitsap County, WA
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: Evergreen lists the themed Tech-O-Ween Dig on Oct 31 at Port Gamble Forest Heritage Park. Check signup and route logistics.
recommendations.why: Unique trail-building event with a community angle, but outside the normal driving radius.

recommendations.title: Swan Creek Dig Day — Trek University Place
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: Evergreen confirms a Nov 1 Swan Creek maintenance work party presented by Trek University Place.
recommendations.why: Low-cost MTB community and trail stewardship, especially useful if you want deeper rider connections.

recommendations.title: Raging River — Over & Out / Wild Waves MTB Day
recommendations.location: Raging River State Forest, North Bend, WA
recommendations.weather: Cold, wet, and possible early snow or freeze-thaw; check pass and trail status
recommendations.description: Ride the newly opened descending trails at Raging River if recent rain and trail conditions permit. Avoid saturated or closed trails; check Evergreen updates.
recommendations.why: New trail mileage at a favorite destination, with the possibility of combining Sunday riding and trail work.

recommendations.title: Eagle Island Southern Idaho Cyclocross Doubleheader
recommendations.timing: Sat Oct 31 and Sun Nov 1; races ~10 AM–1:15 PM
recommendations.location: Eagle Island State Park, Eagle, ID
recommendations.cost: Race entry and Idaho park fees; check organizer
recommendations.weather: Cool fall weather; morning frost and showers possible; check latest forecast
recommendations.description: Twisted Turtle Racing lists both days of Southern Idaho Cyclocross Series at Eagle Island, with multiple skill categories.
recommendations.why: A viable farther race weekend if Boise is appealing, though Spokane and Edgefield rank higher.

recommendations.title: Tranche or Treat — Live Music and Costume Contest
recommendations.location: Tranche Estate, 705 Berney Dr, Walla Walla, WA
recommendations.weather: Cool fall weather; morning frost and showers possible; check latest forecast
recommendations.description: Halloween gathering with food trucks, costume contest and live music from SUM People from 5–7 PM.
recommendations.why: A social Walla Walla evening after a road ride or local morning race.

recommendations.title: Gorillaz — The Mountain Tour
recommendations.cost: Ticket prices vary; official tickets on sale
recommendations.weather: Indoor venue; check travel weather
recommendations.description: Major Halloween-night arena concert with Gorillaz, Little Simz and Deltron 3030.
recommendations.why: One of the weekend's strongest major-concert options if you want a Seattle overnight.

recommendations.title: Kana Winery Halloween Live Music + Costume Contest
recommendations.weather: Indoor venue; check travel weather
recommendations.description: Rod Giles Band plays Halloween-themed rock/blues; costume contest at 8 PM.
recommendations.why: Nearby music and a winery evening with little travel.

recommendations.title: Tri-City Americans vs Medicine Hat Tigers
recommendations.weather: Indoor venue; check travel weather
recommendations.description: Local WHL hockey game on Halloween night, listed in the Tri-Cities weekend events calendar. Verify ticket availability and game status.
recommendations.why: An easy evening spectator-sports option after a morning ride or run.

recommendations.title: Halloween Party — Fallout at Iconic Brewing
recommendations.weather: Indoor venue; check travel weather
recommendations.description: Local live-music Halloween party listed by Tri-City Vibe.
recommendations.why: Low-logistics evening with friends after a full outdoor day.

recommendations.title: Pure Evil — Festival of Fear Haunted Attraction
recommendations.location: 10 E Bruneau Ave, Building C, Kennewick, WA
recommendations.weather: Indoor venue; check travel weather
recommendations.description: Two haunted attractions, a midway and escape-room options. Confirm exact Friday/Saturday session before booking.
recommendations.why: A stronger local Halloween-night alternative than generic trick-or-treat events.

recommendations.title: Broadmoor Halloween Spooktacular
recommendations.weather: Cool late-October conditions, roughly 40s mornings and 50s afternoons; confirm daily forecast and wind
recommendations.description: Community Halloween gathering with games, costumes, vendors and refreshments.
recommendations.why: Easy no-cost local Friday option.

recommendations.title: Badger / Candy Mountain Endurance Hill Repeats
recommendations.timing: Sat or Sun; self-guided daylight session
recommendations.location: Badger Mountain and Candy Mountain, Richland, WA
recommendations.weather: Cool late-October conditions, roughly 40s mornings and 50s afternoons; confirm daily forecast and wind
recommendations.description: Build a 2–3-hour hilly trail session with repeat climbs and runnable connecting trails. Not an organized event; watch footing and daylight.
recommendations.why: Practical training for the March 50-miler without a long drive or late race entry.

recommendations.title: Walla Walla Fall Road Ride + Winery Stop
recommendations.timing: Sat or Sun; self-guided daylight ride
recommendations.weather: Cool fall weather; morning frost and showers possible; check latest forecast
recommendations.description: Build a 40–70-mile road loop in the Walla Walla valley, then pair it with Tranche's Saturday Halloween gathering. Not an organized race.
recommendations.why: High-quality aerobic miles with a social destination.

recommendations.title: Folklore Brewing Halloween Live Music
recommendations.weather: Cool fall weather; morning frost and showers possible; check latest forecast
recommendations.description: Live music from Crawford & Marshall at the Enterprise brewery on Halloween night.
recommendations.why: Combine with a Wallowas fall outing if conditions support a longer weekend.

recommendations.title: Seaside Witches & Warlocks Paddle
recommendations.cost: Event fee not stated; equipment/travel extra
recommendations.weather: Cool and potentially wet, with slick trails and muddy courses; confirm Friday forecast
recommendations.description: Costumed kayak, canoe or paddleboard gathering during Seaside Halloween Happenin's. Rain-or-shine; bring appropriate cold-water protection.
recommendations.why: An unusual water-sports event, but too far to justify unless already heading to the coast.
